summary.title: Allocation readiness review after structured origin audit
summary.description: This example represents a case where a trace claim has been sufficiently organized for downstream allocation-readiness review, while still not performing or approving allocation.

trace_claim.claim_statement: The trace relationship has been observed, reviewed, and documented well enough to be considered for downstream allocation-readiness review.

derived_or_later_work.title: Later Work Using Reviewed Trace Structure
derived_or_later_work.creator: Later Creator

evidence_items.description: The later work includes a direct reference to the origin candidate.
observed_features: named reference to the original framework

evidence_items.description: The later work follows a structure that aligns with the origin candidate's framework.
observed_features: similar separation between trace, review, and allocation

evidence_items.description: The trace claim has undergone preliminary human or multi-wing review.
No active dispute is recorded for this example at the time of review.

evidence.evidence_summary: The trace claim includes explicit reference, structural alignment, preliminary review records, and no active dispute in this example.

audit_assessment.assessment_summary: The trace claim appears sufficiently organized for downstream allocation-readiness review, but this does not mean allocation is approved.
uncertainty_notes: Allocation readiness is not the same as allocation approval.
This audit does not determine ownership, authorship, legal status, or royalty distribution.
Contribution weight must be determined by a separate allocation or royalty process.
If a dispute arises later, allocation review should be paused or reopened.

review_notes: The evidence is organized enough for downstream allocation-readiness consideration.
Reviewers should confirm that no active dispute exists before escalation.
Reviewers should preserve the distinction between trace evidence and allocation decision.
Further governance checks are required before any royalty allocation.

dispute_notes: No active dispute is recorded in this example.
If a dispute is later registered, this readiness status should be reconsidered.

allocation_readiness.reason: The claim has sufficient structured evidence, review notes, and dispute-status clarification to proceed to a separate allocation-readiness or royalty review process.
required_before_allocation: licensing or permission review if applicable
separate Royalty OS or Allocation Layer decision
allocation_readiness.recommended_next_step: Escalate to a dedicated Allocation Readiness or Royalty OS process without treating this audit as an allocation decision.

notes: The preliminary weight is a descriptive review signal only.
It is not a royalty percentage.
Allocation weight must be determined by a separate downstream process.

governance_notes.principle: Allocation readiness means a claim may proceed to downstream allocation review; it does not approve payment, ownership, or royalty distribution.
